Responsible Gaming

We value our casino players at WSM Casino and we always have your best interests in mind. Not only do we create amazing gaming experiences packed with bonuses and free spins, but we also want to ensure that your experience is always positive.

Our goal here is to ensure that gambling always stays fun for you. So here are some helpful tips for responsible gambling.

Stick to Your Deposit Limit

Think about how much you can afford to gamble before you start gambling. Ensure that the amounts you play are for your enjoyment and for fun.

Avoid Trying to Win Back a Loss at Every Cost

Don't take too many risks trying to win back what you lost. Don't play for money, but for entertainment.

Set Yourself a Time Limit for Playing

Make a time limit for yourself and don't break it. It is important to keep gambling in balance with other hobbies and not just gambling for the sake of gambling.

Always Play Smart

You should avoid playing if you are extremely stressed, depressed, or under too much pressure. In addition, do not play while impaired by medications, drugs, or alcohol.

Take Regular Breaks

When you notice that you are getting tired or can't concentrate anymore, you should take a break.

Use Only One Account

When it comes to gambling, it is highly recommended that you don't have more than one account per person to keep track of how much time and money you spend.

Our Commitment to Minor Protection 

We also want to ensure that WSM Casino is only used by those who meet our strict requirements. Our service is available to people 18 years and older. Please keep your login data safe from minors around you to prevent abuse.

Furthermore, we recommend a filter program to prevent minors, especially children, from accessing age-restricted content on the internet. More information can be found here.

Self-Exclusion at WSM Casino

If you are suffering from a gambling addiction or you want to stay away from gambling for another reason, we want to assist you to do so. 

When you "Self-Exclude," you do so by choosing to exclude yourself from all gambling services. This exclusion cannot be undone for a set amount of time. We recommend that you message our support and give them a timeframe between six months and five years if you wish to self-exclude from gambling. They will also explain the next steps and what is expected of you.

For your protection, Self-Exclusion is permanent for the specified period of time and will not be revoked until the time limit has concluded completely.

Any attempt to create a new account during Self Exclusion is a violation of our Terms of Service and may result in the permanent ban of your original account.
